purpose: Second single-run diagnostic A/B for v210 Order 73. Preserve v229 structural image evidence and activate the generic strict completion phase for an explicitly singular Writer image insertion at the cursor. This prior-outcome-selected run is not a baseline denominator.
hypothesis: v229 proved that Qwen receives exact +1 image-placement evidence and propose_done is present, but strict_instruction_required_actions did not recognize a singular image insertion whose destination is the Writer cursor. The proactive completion protocol therefore left mutation, search, and GUI tools exposed; GUI notification clicks were treated as intervening state changes and the same non-idempotent insertion ran repeatedly. If a focused generic semantic parser recognizes only explicit singular cursor-targeted image insertion, the successful model-selected mutation will restrict the next turn to document.inspect and the verified read-back will restrict the following turn to propose_done.
change_scope: A focused writer_image_semantics module recognizes singular insert/paste/place/add/copy image requests targeted at a Writer cursor, caret, or insertion point. It rejects plural requests, source-direction copies, and unrelated cursor edits. instruction_semantics maps only that reusable intent to image.insert_at_cursor, allowing the existing strict completion state machine to expose read-back and then propose_done. No model argument is created or rewritten; Runner execution, Adapter behavior, tool schema, evaluator, and task identity isolation are unchanged from v229.

sources.v229_outcome: Strict evidence-valid failure: reward 0.0, generic_api_plus_gui, 30 steps, no Agent termination. Qwen grew the live graphic-object count from 2 to 8 despite receiving exact count deltas and non-repetition guidance because the strict completion phase never activated.

implementation_evidence.counterfactuals: Three distinct singular paraphrases route to image.insert_at_cursor. Four negative cases cover copying from under the cursor to Desktop, two screenshots, several photos, and unrelated highlight removal. A synthetic strict episode verifies exact model arguments, inspect-only exposure after mutation, and propose_done-only exposure after read-back.
implementation_evidence.focused_tests: 56 passed across Writer image semantics and generic completion policy
implementation_evidence.ruff: passed for active source, scripts, and tests

selection.method: same fixed regression item, second evidence-backed reusable hypothesis after inspecting the preserved v229 actual model request and tool surface
